artifact_replaced.reason_given: the two previous AB records carried a MIS-SPECIFIED control: it compared the sum of ALL counters (including the impact resolutions hit/spared) with the token count, so it read False on a correct record -- 18 outcomes against 9 tokens. The per-token counters and the impact counters obey two different equalities and both now travel per cell. The replaced record's digest is in artifact_replaced
artifact_replaced.reading: THIS RUN REPLACED THE RECORD AT THIS PATH. The replaced record is NOT recoverable from this file: what survives is that it existed, the digest of the bytes it was, and what it said about its own instrument.
